identityPolicy: Sorted original element IDs allocate positive numeric page-local IDs; sorted relationship IDs follow the largest element ID. Stable external identities live in taxonomy.id Shape Data, independently of numeric IDs and display names.
timestampPolicy: For reproducibility, the generation timestamp is normalized to snapshotCreatedAt and marked SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_CREATED_AT. Unbound diagrams omit the timestamp.

mappings.target: typed taxonomy.* Shape Data and manifest
mappings.rationale: Arbitrary nonblank Taxonomy types retain their exact meaning as properties; Visio rectangles have no architecture metamodel type.

mappings.target: typed taxonomy.* connector Shape Data and manifest
mappings.rationale: Native masterless arrow geometry shows the original source-to-target direction; exact relation semantics remain properties.

mappings.source: authorized snapshot authority and human decisions
mappings.target: OPC custom properties, shape data and manifest
mappings.rationale: Only application-allowlisted values are supplied; unavailable authority and decisions are named in the loss report.
Presentation geometry may differ from SVG/PDF; semantic identities and directions do not depend on layout.

mappings.target: flat rectangle with taxonomy.container=true and original parentId
mappings.rationale: No native nested Visio group semantics are claimed; containers are excluded from the canonical semantic graph hash.
Outside the safe visual handoff profile; separately authorized canonical evidence remains authoritative.
The straight masterless connector profile requires two distinct endpoint positions; no partial artifact is emitted.
Editing or saving a VSDX does not write back to Taxonomy or preserve canonical operation history.
